easy.formula: cookies on tk trays of tw x tl = tw tl tk
full bags not in a full box = (cq // cpb) mod cbb
boxes to pack every cookie = ceil(ceil(cq / cpb) / cbb)
cookies to bake to fill the last bag = cpb ceil(cq / cpb) - cq
grams per batch = gs gpp / bat
visible pots of a triangular pyramid = T(tier) - T(tier - 2), T(n) = n(n+1)(n+2)/6
packets to hold every seed = ceil(sd / spk)
full packets outside full crates = (sd // spk) mod pkc
shelves from a wa-long board: pieces of wb, wc pieces a shelf = (wa // wb) // wc
rows of the last colour = kr - kc ((kr - 1) // kc)

hard.formula: cookies on the rim of tk trays = (2tw + 2tl - 4) tk
cookies off the rim of tk trays = (tw - 2)(tl - 2) tk
pieces after tw cuts across and tl along, tk layers = (tw+1)(tl+1)tk
square tiers 1^2 + ... + ck^2 = ck(ck+1)(2ck+1)/6
candy box ck x (ck+1) x (ck+2) = ck(ck+1)(ck+2)
triangular candy pyramid on a base of side ck+1 = (ck+1)(ck+2)(ck+3)/6
cubes of sugar 1^3 + ... + ck^3 = (ck(ck+1)/2)^2
frosting a square cake = ck^2 + 4 ck tk
three square tiers ck, ck-1, ck-2 of height tk = tk(ck^2 + (ck-1)^2 + (ck-2)^2)
plates for gs guests and 2 hosts over cr courses plus a bread plate = (gs + 2)(cr + 1)
glass clinks among gs guests and 2 hosts, each course = cr (gs+2)(gs+1)/2
dough for gs + 2 servings per batch, bat batches = (gs + 2) gpp bat
plants every bsp along both sides = (bw // bsp + 1)(bln // bsp + 1)
plants on the inner grid points, bsp beds = (bw - 1)(bln - 1) bsp
border of width bsp inside the bed = bw bln - (bw - 2bsp)(bln - 2bsp)
bed left inside a border of width bsp = (bw - 2bsp)(bln - 2bsp)
posts every bsp round the bed = 2(bw // bsp + bln // bsp)
half-depth soil = bw bln bsp / 2
cross-shaped path of width bsp = bsp(bw + bln - bsp)
pots in nbx triangular pyramids = nbx tier(tier+1)(tier+2)/6
pots in nbx square pyramids = nbx tier(tier+1)(2tier+1)/6
plants in nbx triangular beds = nbx tier(tier+1)/2
crates for every seed = ceil(ceil(sd / spk) / pkc)
unpainted unit cubes of a painted cb-cube = (cb - 2)^3
unit cubes with one painted face = 6 (cb - 2)^2
unit cubes with paint = cb^3 - (cb - 2)^3
joints of a cb-cube lattice = (cb + 1)^3
unit rods of a cb-cube lattice = 3 cb (cb + 1)^2
inside of a box with walls 1 = (wa - 2)(wb - 2)(wc - 2)
wood in a closed box with walls 1 = wa wb wc - (wa - 2)(wb - 2)(wc - 2)
pegs on a wa x wb board, one per unit corner, wc boards = (wa + 1)(wb + 1) wc
frame of width wc round a wa x wb picture = (wa + 2wc)(wb + 2wc) - wa wb
dowels every wc on a wa x wb panel = (wa // wc + 1)(wb // wc + 1)
stitches in full kc-row stripes = (kr // kc) kc kst
triangular shawl of kr rows on a kst cast-on = kr kst + kr(kr - 1)/2
